description: This file contains source code for managing chunks and chunk files within the lighttpd server, including functions for creating, freeing, reading, and manipulating chunks, as well as handling file I/O, memory buffers, and resource limits.

classes.name: liChunkFile
classes.description: Represents a chunk file, including its file descriptor, name, and temporary status for managing file-based chunks.

classes.name: liChunk
classes.description: Represents a data chunk, which can be of various types such as string, memory, file, or buffer, and contains associated metadata.

classes.name: liCQLimit
classes.description: Represents a limit on chunk queue memory usage, supporting reference counting and notification callbacks.

classes.name: liChunkQueue
classes.description: A queue of chunks supporting various append, steal, skip, and extract operations, with limit enforcement.

methods.name: liChunkFile * li_chunkfile_new(GString * name,int fd,gboolean is_temp)
methods.description: Creates a new liChunkFile object with given name, file descriptor, and temporary flag.

methods.name: void li_chunkfile_acquire(liChunkFile * cf)
methods.description: Increments the reference count of a liChunkFile.

methods.name: void li_chunkfile_release(liChunkFile * cf)
methods.description: Decrements the reference count and frees a liChunkFile if no longer in use.

methods.name: liHandlerResult li_chunkfile_open(liChunkFile * cf,GError ** err)
methods.description: Opens the file associated with a liChunkFile if it is not already open, handling errors.

methods.name: liChunk * chunk_new(void)
methods.description: Creates a new empty liChunk object.

methods.name: void chunk_free(liChunkQueue * cq,liChunk * c)
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a liChunk object and removes it from its queue.

methods.name: liCQLimit * li_cqlimit_new(void)
methods.description: Creates a new limit object for chunk queue memory.

methods.name: void li_cqlimit_reset(liCQLimit * cql)
methods.description: Resets the state of a limit object.

methods.name: void li_cqlimit_acquire(liCQLimit * cql)
methods.description: Increments the reference count of a limit object.

methods.name: void li_cqlimit_release(liCQLimit * cql)
methods.description: Decrements the reference count of a limit object and frees if reference count reaches zero.

methods.name: void cqlimit_lock(liCQLimit * cql)
methods.description: Locks a limit, updating associated watchers and callbacks.

methods.name: void cqlimit_unlock(liCQLimit * cql)
methods.description: Unlocks a limit, restoring watchers and callbacks.

methods.name: void cqlimit_update(liChunkQueue * cq,goffset d)
methods.description: Updates the memory usage counters and triggers lock/unlock as necessary.

methods.name: void li_cqlimit_set_limit(liCQLimit * cql,goffset limit)
methods.description: Sets the byte limit for a limit object.

methods.name: liChunkQueue * li_chunkqueue_new(void)
methods.description: Creates a new, empty chunk queue.

methods.name: void __chunk_free(gpointer _c,gpointer userdata)
methods.description: Frees a chunk and unlinks it from its queue.

methods.name: void li_chunkqueue_reset(liChunkQueue * cq)
methods.description: Resets a chunk queue, freeing all its chunks.

methods.name: void li_chunkqueue_free(liChunkQueue * cq)
methods.description: Frees the entire chunk queue and its associated resources.

methods.name: void li_chunkqueue_use_limit(liChunkQueue * cq,goffset limit)
methods.description: Applies a memory usage limit to the chunk queue.

methods.name: void li_chunkqueue_set_limit(liChunkQueue * cq,liCQLimit * cql)
methods.description: Assigns a limit object to a chunk queue, updating memory counters accordingly.

methods.name: goffset li_chunkqueue_limit_available(liChunkQueue * cq)
methods.description: Returns the available space in the chunk queue's limit.

methods.name: void li_chunkqueue_append_string(liChunkQueue * cq,GString * str)
methods.description: Appends a string as a chunk to the queue.

methods.name: void li_chunkqueue_append_bytearr(liChunkQueue * cq,GByteArray * mem)
methods.description: Appends a byte array as a chunk.

methods.name: void li_chunkqueue_append_buffer(liChunkQueue * cq,liBuffer * buffer)
methods.description: Appends a buffer reference as a chunk.

methods.name: void li_chunkqueue_append_buffer2(liChunkQueue * cq,liBuffer * buffer,gsize offset,gsize length)
methods.description: Appends a portion of a buffer as a chunk.

methods.name: void li_chunkqueue_append_mem(liChunkQueue * cq,const void * mem,gssize len)
methods.description: Appends raw memory as a chunk.

methods.name: void li_chunkqueue_append_chunkfile(liChunkQueue * cq,liChunkFile * cf,off_t start,off_t length)
methods.description: Appends a chunk file as a chunk.

methods.name: void __chunkqueue_append_file(liChunkQueue * cq,GString * filename,off_t start,off_t length,int fd,gboolean is_temp)
methods.description: Internal function for appending a file chunk, wrapping filename, fd, and temp status.

methods.name: void li_chunkqueue_append_file(liChunkQueue * cq,GString * filename,off_t start,off_t length)
methods.description: Appends a file from a filename to the chunk queue.

methods.name: void li_chunkqueue_append_file_fd(liChunkQueue * cq,GString * filename,off_t start,off_t length,int fd)
methods.description: Appends a file using an already opened file descriptor.

methods.name: void li_chunkqueue_append_tempfile(liChunkQueue * cq,GString * filename,off_t start,off_t length)
methods.description: Appends a temporary file chunk.

methods.name: void li_chunkqueue_append_tempfile_fd(liChunkQueue * cq,GString * filename,off_t start,off_t length,int fd)
methods.description: Appends a temporary file chunk with an open fd.

methods.name: goffset li_chunkqueue_steal_len(liChunkQueue * out,liChunkQueue * in,goffset length)
methods.description: Transfers up to a specified number of bytes from one queue to another.

methods.name: goffset li_chunkqueue_steal_all(liChunkQueue * out,liChunkQueue * in)
methods.description: Transfers all chunks from one queue to another.

methods.name: goffset li_chunkqueue_steal_chunk(liChunkQueue * out,liChunkQueue * in)
methods.description: Transfers the first chunk from one queue to another.

methods.name: goffset li_chunkqueue_skip(liChunkQueue * cq,goffset length)
methods.description: Skips/deletes bytes in the queue.

methods.name: goffset li_chunkqueue_skip_all(liChunkQueue * cq)
methods.description: Removes all data chunks from the queue.

methods.name: gboolean li_chunkqueue_extract_to(liChunkQueue * cq,goffset len,GString * dest,GError ** err)
methods.description: Extracts a certain length of data as a string.

methods.name: gboolean li_chunkqueue_extract_to_memory(liChunkQueue * cq,goffset len,void * dest,GError ** err)
methods.description: Extracts data into a raw memory buffer.

methods.name: gboolean li_chunkqueue_extract_to_bytearr(liChunkQueue * cq,goffset len,GByteArray * dest,GError ** err)
methods.description: Extracts data into a GByteArray.

methods.name: liBuffer * li_chunkqueue_get_last_buffer(liChunkQueue * cq,guint min_space)
methods.description: Returns the last buffer in the queue if suitable for appending more data.

methods.name: LI_API void li_chunkqueue_update_last_buffer_size(liChunkQueue * cq,goffset add_length)
methods.description: Updates the size of the last buffer in the queue after modification.
